fusions.name: Every Step Stings
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 7 poison damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and lays [Cursed Step] on it for 6 seconds, so every step it takes costs it blood. Holds 4 charges; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Followed for Miles
fusions.desc: Spits a long venom shot that deals 28 poison damage and ignores armour. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Shed the Road Dust
fusions.desc: You shed your worn outer skin: you regain 10 health at once and restore 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Road Basking
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.
